baseline_models.focus_anchor: The distributive interrogative bi-ayyi governs alaa, while rabbikuma and tukadhdhiban address two recipients.
baseline_models.mechanism: Plural favors are presented as itemized evidence produced by ownership and stagewise care; the dual addressees are challenged to identify any item they can actively declare false.

activation_trace.role: The literal favor sense supplies the plural evidence distributed by 'which'.
Lordship, ownership, and authority identify whose acts are under examination.
Repair, nurture, and completion make the favors sustained processes rather than isolated gifts.
Declaring a thing or report false supplies the addressees' active response.

changed_reading.before: A generic question about denying blessings.
changed_reading.after: A distributive cross-examination: which concrete act of the Lord's authority and nurture can either addressee actively declare false?

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Alaa, rabbikuma, and tukadhdhiban can be read through oath, pact, and a charge that proves or fails.
baseline_models.mechanism: Three form-distant branches align into a juridical mechanism: a sworn bond under lordship is tested by whether its recipients make good on the charge. Denial becomes failed performance as well as false speech.

activation_trace.role: The oath-making image supplies a possible binding commitment inside alaa.
The pact or protection-bond image makes the relation to the Lord covenantal.
A charge proving true or failing turns denial into failure to carry an entrusted demand through.

changed_reading.before: Denial is only an opinion or utterance.
changed_reading.after: The question also probes covenantal performance: which binding claim of your Lord will your conduct fail to make true?

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The dual suffix in rabbikuma and dual verb tukadhdhiban coexist with a split alaa inventory containing sequence and voice-following-voice.
baseline_models.mechanism: The grammar supplies two respondents, while the non-dominant mapped root supplies sequential and antiphonal following. The question can therefore function as a prompt awaiting two successive voices, not merely as narration about two groups.

activation_trace.role: Following in sequence supplies the ordered response mechanism.
One voice following another turns the dual address into a possible antiphon.
Shared lordship gives the two respondents one authority before whom they answer.
The act of declaring false supplies the answer demanded from each voice.

changed_reading.before: One speaker asks a rhetorical question about two absent parties.
changed_reading.after: The line can be heard as an antiphonal prompt in which two addressed communities must answer in sequence before their common Lord.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening sequence presents mercy, gathered recitation, measured creation, and disclosed meaning as one curriculum of formation. This strongly activates rabb as stagewise nurture and makes denial a refusal of the very process that equips the addressee to recognize.

activation_trace.role: Stagewise repair, nurture, and completion supply the focus line's formative agent.
Bestowed favors name the formative acts being reviewed.
Declaring false becomes refusal to acknowledge the process that formed the declarer.
Mercy and tenderness set care, rather than bare domination, as the sequence's initiating quality.
A thing becoming disclosed to a knower makes teaching an act of cognitive unveiling.
Gathering and collection make revelation an ordered body rather than scattered information.
Proportioning and measuring make creation a calibrated stage in formation.
Disclosing meaning by speech or sign gives the formed human a means to recognize and answer.

structural_cues: 55:1-4 forms a tight agent-action-object chain: mercy, teaching, creating, then teaching expression.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: a care/disclosure/collection/proportion/expression sequence. Reader: these acts instantiate rabb's stagewise nurture and produce the respondent capable of recognition. Alternative: the opening may simply enumerate distinct favors without one developmental arrow.

changed_reading.before: The favors are external benefits presented to an already complete observer.
changed_reading.after: The favors include the curriculum that formed the observer's body, knowledge, and expressive capacity, so denial turns those received capacities against their source.

context_deltas.mechanism: Counting, balance, equity, and short measure recast takdhib as a distorted appraisal. The addressees do not only say that favors are false; they undercount, misweight, or short-change their evidentiary value.

activation_trace.role: Favors provide the items whose worth is being assessed.
A charge proving or failing supplies a performance test rather than a merely verbal verdict.
Counting and account turn the ordered cosmos into quantifiable evidence.
The balance of justice supplies the norm by which acknowledgment is weighed.
Equity and fair dealing make accurate valuation an ethical obligation.
Giving short measure supplies the mechanism for denial as deliberate undervaluation.

structural_cues: 55:7-9 repeats the balance lexeme across establishment, prohibition, and command.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: cosmic calculation is followed by commands for just measure and no shortfall. Reader: the refrain audits acknowledgment by the same calibration logic. Alternative: measurement governs commerce and order while takdhib remains ordinary propositional denial.

changed_reading.before: Denial means rejecting a true statement.
changed_reading.after: Denial also means falsifying the account: assigning the Lord's favors too little weight despite a calibrated field of evidence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The unusual capacity branch of alaa is activated by an explicit test of ability, passage through boundaries, and authorizing power. Favors become capacities whose limits disclose that ability is granted rather than self-grounding.

activation_trace.role: Being able to do something turns alaa from possessed goods toward granted capacities.
Authority and possession identify the source and governor of those capacities.
Declaring false becomes disowning both a capacity and its dependence.
Ability and power explicitly pose what the two communities can accomplish.
Clean passage to the other side supplies the attempted exercise and boundary of capacity.
Power and delegated authority supply the condition under which passage becomes possible.

structural_cues: 55:33 addresses jinn and humans together, repeats the penetration verb, and closes with an exception introduced by illa.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: ability, boundary-crossing, and authority are explicitly linked. Reader: capacity itself is one alaa and its limit reveals lordship. Alternative: the passage is solely a challenge or threat, not an inventory of bestowed ability.

changed_reading.before: Alaa are benefits lying outside the recipients.
changed_reading.after: Alaa also include the recipients' powers and their authorized limits: which capacity of your Lord will you falsely treat as self-originating or unlimited?

context_deltas.mechanism: Exact recurrence before and after 55:67 activates the split-root images of sequence and one voice following another. Each refrain receives the preceding scene, calls for two answers, and then yields to another evidentiary scene.

activation_trace.role: Voice following voice gives the focus occurrence an antiphonal response pattern.
Declaring false names the answer that the recurring prompt repeatedly solicits.
Following in sequence makes the prior identical refrain a structural predecessor to 55:67.
The next identical occurrence supplies another responding voice after fresh garden evidence.
Repeated declaration-of-falsehood language resets the demand for an answer.

structural_cues: The exact focus sentence occurs 31 times including 55:67; here it stands between the dual gushing springs of 55:66 and fruit, palms, and pomegranates in 55:68.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: exact recurrence, dual grammar, and sequence/voice branches. Reader: recurrence is responsorial and each scene is evidence placed between answers. Alternative: repetition may remain a unilateral rhetorical refrain with no performed audience response.

changed_reading.after: 55:67 is one turn in a litany: it gathers the preceding image, prompts two sequential responses, and opens onto the next item of evidence.

context_deltas.mechanism: Perishing versus remaining and action answered by recompense activate the non-dominant alaa branches of remainder and a right that follows its holder. A favor can be heard as generating a surviving claim upon its recipient; denial is repudiation of that claim.

activation_trace.role: A remainder following what came before lets received favor persist beyond the passing scene.
A liability or right following its holder turns persistence into an outstanding claim.
The pact image supplies the relation within which the claim remains binding.
A charge failing to prove true makes denial a default in performance.
Cessation and disappearance after duration establish what does not survive.
The residue that remains supplies the contrasting persistence.
Collecting and satisfying a debt makes reciprocal response resemble settlement of a claim.
Good action repeated on both sides supplies the reciprocal substance of the settlement.

structural_cues: 55:26-27 sharply opposes universal passing to divine remaining; 55:60 mirrors ihsan on both sides of illa.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: remainder, following liability, survival, debt satisfaction, and reciprocal good. Reader: a received favor leaves a claim that follows the recipient. Alternative: the relation is gratitude and recompense without juridical debt.

changed_reading.before: A favor is consumed and then belongs to the past.
changed_reading.after: A favor leaves a surviving relational claim: which outstanding right generated by your Lord's good will you repudiate rather than answer?

context_deltas.mechanism: Running provision, a water source, abundant gushing, and edible fruit activate the rare kadhaba idiom of milk disappearing or failing to last. Denial becomes the allegation that the Lord's provision did not hold or meet expectation, precisely where the context depicts renewed outflow and yield.

activation_trace.role: Milk failing expectation supplies a material sense of provision that disappears or does not last.
Nurture and completion identify continuing provision as the Lord's work.
Bestowed favors supply the expected provision whose reliability is contested.
Continuity of sustenance and giving establishes provision as an ongoing current.
A source of running water locates the provision in a renewable spring.
Water welling abundantly contradicts the image of a supply that fails.
Pleasant edible fruit supplies the downstream yield of the water.

structural_cues: 55:67 is enclosed by dual gushing springs at 55:66 and a three-part fruit list at 55:68.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: continuing giving, spring source, abundant outflow, fruit, and a focus-root idiom for failed milk. Reader: the water-to-fruit sequence answers an accusation of failed provision. Alternative: the milk idiom is too remote and tukadhdhiban simply means deny.

changed_reading.before: The verb names only abstract disbelief.
changed_reading.after: The verb can materially charge the pair with calling sustained provision a failed promise, even as water visibly wells into fruit-bearing abundance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The non-dominant mapping of rabb toward increase, rising, and growth is activated by the raised heaven, eruptive water, and luxuriant green life. Rabbikuma can resonate as an active raiser and grower while retaining the dominant lordship reading.

activation_trace.role: Increase and rising give rabbikuma an exploratory upward and expansive dynamic.
Nourishing and growing up connect that rising dynamic to nurture.
Favors are the visible products of raising and growth.
Raising a thing supplies the cosmic-scale upward motion.
Abundant welling water supplies outward pressure and life-bearing emergence.
Luxuriance, ease, and flourishing life supply the matured result of nurture.

structural_cues: A long arc runs from the heaven raised in 55:7 through the water erupting immediately before 55:67 to luxuriant green at 55:76.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: split rabb mapping plus rise, growth, outflow, and flourishing branches. Reader: these form one vertical metabolism of raising. Alternative: the non-dominant mapping is only formal noise and rabb should retain authority/nurture without an upward resonance.

changed_reading.before: Rabbikuma is a static title attached to a list of favors.
changed_reading.after: Rabbikuma can also be heard dynamically as the one continually raising, feeding, and bringing latent abundance into flourishing form.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it combines womb branches of mercy and recitation with nurture; it remains anchored in rabbikuma and tukadhdhiban and in the opening formation sequence. Render it as a gestational analogy, not as the lexical translation of al-Rahman or al-Quran.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Rabbikuma supplies stagewise nurture and tukadhdhiban makes the formed addressee deny that nurture.

activation_trace.role: Nurture toward completion gives the focus line a gestational process anchor.
Declaring false makes the completed creature reject the process that bore it.
The female womb supplies a containing matrix for mercy's action.
A womb gathering a pregnancy makes recitation's collection image gestational.
Bringing creation into existence supplies emergence from the gathered matrix.

changed_reading.before: Revelation, creation, and mercy are parallel but separate favors.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, mercy gathers revelation like a womb gathers life, and the refrain asks whether the formed recipient will deny the gestational disclosure that brought it to recognition.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because plant beauty with bitterness and patterned cloth that deceives are peripheral focus branches. It remains anchored in alaa and tukadhdhiban and is reinforced by colored, coated, lined, patterned, and identifying surfaces; downstream prose should present a reversible surface analogy, not claim that the verse calls the garden deceptive.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Alaa carries a beautiful-but-bitter plant image, while tukadhdhiban carries an appearance that deceives by its condition.

activation_trace.role: A plant attractive in appearance but bitter in taste separates visible allure from experienced substance.
Variegated cloth that deceives by its condition makes falsehood a property of display.
Flower and rose-red coloration supply an overwhelming visible surface.
Oil or coating supplies a surface whose appearance depends on what covers it.
A garment's inner lining introduces the hidden side beneath display.
Fine patterned carpets reactivate the focus image of variegated textile display.
Recognition through a trace or sign reverses deceptive appearance into evidentiary appearance.
A visible identifying mark makes bodily surface disclose rather than conceal truth.

changed_reading.before: Denial is detached from perception, and beauty transparently signifies favor.
changed_reading.after: The refrain can test surface judgment: appearances may seduce or deceive, yet marks can also expose, so which manifestation is being falsified by the observer's own way of seeing?

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates last-breath and run-then-stop branches from split or remote senses. It remains anchored in alaa and tukadhdhiban and gains structure from the repeated refrain beside the perish/remain contrast; render it only as a rhythmic mortality metaphor, never as a direct lexical gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus alaa maps to a last-breath branch, and tukadhdhiban maps to motion that stops and looks back.

activation_trace.role: The last-breath image makes each utterance a finite pulse at the edge of cessation.
Running a stage, stopping, and looking back supplies the refrain's retrospective checkpoint.
Disappearance after duration gives the rhythmic stop its mortality horizon.
Continuance and remaining supply what persists beyond each finite pulse.
Sequential following makes the earlier refrain one completed stage before the focus pulse.

changed_reading.before: Repetition merely emphasizes the same proposition.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, each refrain is a breath-stop that turns back over the scene just traversed before the sequence continues, measuring finite recipients against what remains.

strongest_changes: Rabbikuma moved from a static title to stagewise formation through mercy, teaching, measured creation, and disclosure.
Takdhib became miscalibration and short measure as well as verbal denial.
Alaa expanded from external favors to granted capacities, reliable provision, and, exploratorily, surviving relational claims.
The repeated dual question became a responsorial hinge between successive scenes of evidence.
Non-dominant mappings preserved coexisting readings of sequence, remainder, liability, rising, and growth.
summary.what_was_special: The packet's split mappings were unusually productive: ء ل و -> ت ل و connected the refrain to sequence, antiphony, remainder, liability, and last breath, while ر ب ب -> ر ب و connected lordship to rising and growth. The immediate spring/refrain/fruit frame also activated a material allegation of provision failing expectation.
remaining_uncertainties: The ت ل و and ر ب و activations are form-distant and should coexist with, not replace, the dominant favor and lordship readings.
Oath, pact, debt, and surviving claim may over-juridicize a relation that can instead be gratitude and reciprocal good.
Gestational, deceptive-surface, and last-breath models are branch-backed analogies, not lexical translations.
